draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 15th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 2nd of 20 at DT. He went 14th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Michael Brockers. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2019, 4th of 20 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 75 career games and 62 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 63.6% (87th percentile), tackles for loss 5 (76th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 14.0% (9th percentile), sacks 0.0 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 interior lineman who played: 5 pressures against a median of 5 (level with).
